about: Natal gear (本命) of the 26 summonable heroines: always Divine, from Mahayana on, forged from ten fragments.

records.name: Thousand-Floret Edge
records.effect: Climbing Blooms no longer resets each turn: it climbs across the whole battle up to +90%, but falls to zero whenever she takes a critical hit

records.name: Empty Valley Qin-Sword
records.effect: Accompanying Wind follows every ally technique that hits, area ones included, for 35% ATK, once per ally each turn: she becomes the song under the whole team's strikes

records.name: Fire-Pomegranate Sabre
records.effect: Pomegranate Skirt Whirl strikes twice for 40% ATK and each hit adds a Sword Wound stack: she becomes the team's stack engine

records.name: Stone Pillow Greatsword
records.effect: Rude Awakening grows with every hit she takes, +10% each up to +50%, until she next casts: she becomes a counter-puncher who wants to be hit

records.name: Bodhi Bronze Bell
records.effect: Golden Bell Shield covers the ally with the lowest health instead of herself while she still Provokes every enemy: she turns from wall to bodyguard

records.name: Purple Vine Armlet
records.effect: Clinging Vine shelters every ally, not only her neighbours, and she takes 10% of the damage they take: the whole team leans on her

records.name: Snow-Camellia Teapot
records.effect: Whole-Bloom Fall pours all its shielding into the most injured ally at three times the strength: she turns from team guard to one ally's bodyguard

records.name: Cuckoo-Blood Bracer
records.effect: Weeping Blood Bloom no longer Provokes: for 2 turns she counterattacks every enemy that hits any ally, so she turns from taunter to the whole team's thorn

records.name: Wei Purple Jade Seal
records.effect: Unbowed Before the Empress also reflects every debuff cast on an ally that turn back at its caster: she turns from shield to mirror

records.name: Rainstorm Needle Case
records.effect: Rainstorm Pear Blossom Needles pours all nine hits into one enemy and readies Pear Petal Needles: she turns from sweeper to boss breaker

records.name: Blue Kite Letter-Knife
records.effect: While she has Shadow Veil, each of her techniques gives the next ally to cast +20% damage: she turns from striker to messenger

records.name: Crimson Moon Thorn Hairpin
records.effect: Every Rose Has Thorns triggers when any ally is hit, not only her: the whole team carries her thorns

records.name: Bamboo-Leaf Viper Fangs
records.effect: Poison Without Order counts every cast that does not extend a chain, chain starts and holds included: she thrives in any casting order

records.name: Jasmine Ink Brush
records.effect: Scripture of Silence hits every enemy for 50% ATK and Seals the Meridians of the enemy whose ultimate is closest: she turns from duelist to ultimate-stopper

records.name: Peachwood Door-God Sword
records.effect: Shentu and Yulei wards every ally again at the start of each wave, and each blocked debuff strikes its caster for 50% ATK

records.name: Wave-Treading Mirror
records.effect: The reflection stays for 2 turns and recasts the first ally technique of each of your turns at 50% power: she turns from burst to echo

records.name: Golden Crow Array Flag
records.effect: First Light shines at the start of every wave and also pushes every enemy's ultimate 1 turn further away

records.name: Mother's Hall Talisman Box
records.effect: Forget-Sorrow Talisman makes one enemy forget its closest technique, which returns to its full cooldown: she turns from area control into an ultimate eraser

records.name: Guanghan Moon Mirror
records.effect: Wu Gang's Endless Axe also grows at the start of each of your turns, not only when cast: she turns from burst caster into a slow-rising storm

records.name: Spring Thunder Fan
records.effect: Thunder Wakes the Insects strikes four times for 20% ATK each and readies Apricot Rain: she turns into a Qi shield breaker

records.name: Tianshan Ice Orb
records.effect: Snowline Petal hits every enemy for 40% ATK with a 15% chance each to Frost Seal: she turns from striker into a freeze lottery

records.name: Cloud-Climbing Jade Orb
records.effect: Borrowed Height counts every buff on her whole team, +5% damage each up to +40%: she climbs on everyone's support

records.name: Eastern Fence Whisk
records.effect: Chrysanthemum Tea removes every debuff from one ally and gives it Clear Heart for 2 turns instead of healing the team: she turns from healer to purifier

records.name: Red Thread Lily Lamp
records.effect: Red Thread Bloom also ties the two most injured allies, splitting the damage either takes between them for 2 turns: she turns from healer to matchmaker

records.name: Five-Colour Embroidered Ball
records.effect: Changing Soil gives the buff of every phase already cast this turn, not only her own: the longer the chain before her, the more she gives

records.name: Safflower Rouge Cauldron
records.effect: Red Flower Cautery spends 20% of her health but also revives a fallen ally at 30% health: she becomes a medic who pays in blood
